why: llms.txt appears in 131 package commits and is hand-merged: parallel leads would conflict on it. It is derived data, so it stops being committed.
what: llms.txt is generated at build and release, untracked and gitignored, and no longer a semantic-release git asset. The gen-llms --check gate is replaced by a tarball assertion.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 3.2 and 11 (hot files). Makefile and ci.yml are edited by other Issues too: touch only the lines that run gen-llms --check, and keep both sides on a rebase conflict. Insufficient contract: factory signal, reversible default, PR body says so.
exemplar: gen-llms.ts --check semantics; the prepareCmd in .releaserc.json already runs gen-llms.
change: Generate llms.txt in the package build and prepareCmd; `git rm --cached` it and add it to .gitignore; remove it from the @semantic-release/git assets (MIGRATING.md stays an asset). Replace the gen-llms --check lines in the Makefile and ci.yml with a pack-test assertion that the tarball llms.txt names every runtime subpath of package.json exports. If untracking breaks check-agent-doc-drift or pack-test, keep it tracked, keep the check and signal: say in the PR body which of the two you shipped.
commits: One PR; package commit (gen-llms, pack-test.sh, git rm --cached) then a non-package `ci:` commit for .releaserc.json, .gitignore, Makefile and ci.yml (deep review). Conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: make check green on a tree where llms.txt is not tracked.
acceptance: Shipped path A: git ls-files packages/basalt-ui/llms.txt prints nothing and grep -c 'llms.txt' .releaserc.json prints 0 (MIGRATING.md is still listed there). Or path B, after a signal: the file stays tracked and the PR body says why.
pack-test fails when a seeded tarball llms.txt lacks a runtime subpath, and passes on the real build (path A).
out_of_scope: Migration rows (v3-unhot-migrating-llms), export-surface.json, llms-full.txt, writing real rows.
